notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver.291
notes.content:
- Mercenary Bot's can now fill missing slots in parties set by the party leader
  * A full party that contains a bot will still be joinable by other real player's
  * If autojoin is on a player will automatically replace a random bot
- Gem craft speed has been increase by 2x
- Gem Growth per Ascend has been capped at Ascend 125, After 125 its just 1.45m gem levels needed per ascend
- Amount of power from Gems to floor has increased by another 5%
- Frag cost has been removed from WeaponMaster
- Frags spend on evolving will be refunded automatically on first login into this build
- Amount needed to level server quest's has been reduced
- Clicker Game has been modified
  * It's Click feature has been replaced with Auto Clicking
  * Auto Click Time can be bought with Crypt Tokens up to 24 hours
  * Cost will increase based on your personal Click level
  * Free Clicks will also occur on floor changes
- Chimera Boss texture is fixed
- Base floor mod that was applied to Caverns and FFTT has been removed as it hasn't been needed since floor mod

notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver.290
notes.content:
- Increased the Usable Gem level modifier from 15% of Ascend level to 20%
- Added 2 New Server Quest Mults that will unlock soon
- Fixed the Shard Pet to prevent it from gradually floating away
- Added the Colosseum Boss model
- Fixed bug with overall Astral Fragments being incorrect 
- Fixed a bad shader on Library Boss book binding

notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver.289
notes.content:
- Gear set should now swap properly when going into events when in boss rush mode
- Guild Quest point weekend mult should now work correctly
- Sealbonus is now applied to UltDamage
- Guild Talent "Crit Damage Cap" renamed to "Crit Damage"
- Seal "Shield Pen" renamed to "Shield Damage"
- Stat "ExtraCritDamage" renamed to "ExtraCritChance"
- Charm System has been re-worked to allow you to select 1 from each category(Attack,Defense,Utility) to allow for better customization.
- Small improvement to Auto Gem crafting to switch gems faster and increase by 10k instead of 1k

notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver.288.1-288.2
notes.content:
Ver.288.1 
- ClickRaid Mini-game mob now auto destructs at 15%
- Quest points will now be multiplied by weekend buff active buff level
- Fixed an issue with Weapon Master support buff clearing itself
- Fixed a few server bugs and removed some debug outputs

Ver.288.2
- Possible fix for gear not changing after auto reconnect when manually changing gear
- Possible fix ClickerGame < 10% Self Destruct should work every time now
- Changed how presets load and should no longer cause odd things to happen when a preset has never been setup
- Gear Stats should update correctly when changed now, last build prevented them from clearing correctly
- Weapon Master Support role fixed for hopefully the last time
- Prestige will now halve your current floor instead of going back to floor 1 when floor > 1mil
- Updated Gear Items will now display regardless of filter settings when looking at gear
- Fixed case when evolving in weapon master resulted in a NaN/Inf result and now recalculates level from the pieces collected

notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver.288
notes.content:
- Added Setting to enable music when window losses focus
- Fixed music seek error that was popping up randomly since last build
- Server side code optimization pass should result in reduced pings
- Client optimization pass as well
- Discovered/fixed the cause of gold mult on first Boss battle kill being terrible, this bug might have also caused some other mults to occasionally reset when they shouldn't have server side
- Added support for Cosmetic pets
- Fixed an issue with Charm Sync list breaking for newer players and presets

notes.title: ClickRaid V.287
notes.content:
Backend Changes 
- Improvements to object pooler
- Refactor on Dungeon Spawner

Fixs
- Fixed the camera positioning after closing the Clickraid MiniGame
- Fixed Auto Reconnect 
- Fixed going to character select
- Mobs no longer huddle on top the player in caverns
- Netid not existing warning in console should be fixed

Improvements
- Player should now sync to exact position the server is at fixing many of the higher player speed visual bugs
- Sound settings are now setting the volume sliders correctly on startup
- Sound now disables when application loses focus
- ClickRaid mini game left click hold / left clicking is much more accurate and responsive
- Decreased projectile Travel speed so you can see what your shooting
- All Green Crystals in caverns now respawn on floor change
- Added a default cursor
- Slight improvement to movement sync

Features
- Can now change class in real time through Dungeon Options, you no longer need to reset skills(DM me if you experience any bugs with this)

notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver.286
notes.content:
- CheckElementsSelf should be displaying self and not party now
- Fixed "Invite or join party" text that was displaying on top of group members
- Floor mod display value should always report the current value for everyone
- Added 2 new Leader boards Charm level and Weapon master level
- Possible fix for the first ascend 100k gem level bug, Gems will now have all bonuses displayed on initial craft to be less misleading
- Charm Swapping is back to changing instantly
- Fixed bug with UI not fully closing when going to character select after being logged in
- ClickRaid Mini-Game has a new icon
- Added new damage mult based on your Clicker Level from the Mini-Game
- Changed the min/max angle you can rotate the ClickRaid mobs
- Guild list is now sorted Online Players then Alpha
- Server Quest Points is now awarded for any quest that you complete
- New Cosmetics have been added
- Library is no longer borrowing Crypt Boss door
- Library has its own Unique Boss
- Updated the Network Asset to latest build
- Updated to Unity version 2019.4.2f1
- Optimized some of the player and mob state machine's to perform slightly better
- Fixed issue with ClickRaid Mini-Game not registering clicks when Low FPS mode was enabled

notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver.270 Small Client Patch
notes.content:
-Fix for Camera Disable on Disconnect or Char Select returning a null
-Can now type /help in chat to see current public commands
-Added /CheckElements command, this shows the current buff level and XP as if everyone in party has Contribute Elements toggled
-Fix for UI Shortcuts(bottom right corner) bunching up on some clients

notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver.259
notes.content:
- Evolution now gives a bonus to dropped Arena Medals, based on it's level.
- Added Elements to the Weapon Master System
- Fire: Increases Damage & Health, and is found in ALL dungeons.
- Earth: Increases Crit Damage & Healing, and is found in Cavern.
- Wind: Increases Dot Potency & Defense Pen, and is found in FFTT.
- Water: Increases Shield Damage & Defense, and is found in Survival.
- Players will need to select contribute in the Weapon Master UI, to increase the buffs power for the party.
- Elements are consumed on use.
- Only the Party Leader can activate Elements for the party.
- Icons added next to your, and party names. These indicate the role that is selected, and if you or your party are contributing Elements.
- Max element level is limited by the (Max Ascend level in party / 2).
- Activating Elements, will put your party in Boss Rush Mode.
- In Boss Rush, each chest spawns 1 boss, and the floors increase by T100.
- Element activation also buffs cool down and cast time by 50%.

Rogue
- Updated Weapon Master panel with elements.
- Fixed Position of Shaman Staff, so it stays upright.
- Fixed Weapon Master level up button, so it does not interferes with the Ascend Button.
- Fixed Gem Level Amount button, so that it no longer interferes with the Equipment Button.
- Fixed Text Color on Charm UI, so its all the same color.

notes.title: ClickRaid2 Ver 138.5
notes.content:
-Change how Defense Scales in a good way
-Healing should no longer feel like an impossible task
-Fixed Boss Battle boss damage calculation not using the actual targets health as a base
-Fixed Defense to HP bug giving way more HP than it should have
-Fixed Shortcut menus opening on game load
-Fixed Tombstone being under the world
-Resized enemy models a little
-Changed some shader's to look a little better
-Fixed Boss Battle Timer to prevent it from disappearing
-Horde should start 5min after Boss Battle Finishes on the 2 hour 10min mark

Art Dev(Rogue) Changes
- The following icons (assets) were changed to match the new art style:
Various UI Elements
*Class
*Skill
*Talent
*Seals
*Gems & Pet Soul
- Buff Shop had a makeover.
- No more spazzy Talent tree.

notes.title: ClickRaid2 V.0072(mini patch)
notes.content:
-Fixed case where you would get thrown to progression after Boss Battle if tank and leader aren't the same
-Fix for setting high-stage going to boss battle max stage after boss battle
-Added GM commands  to fix high stage issue for those that needed set back.
-Enabled all party member targeting in survival so they aren't just getting targets from the tank.
-Swapped 2x Health server buff with 2x Gem shard gains
-Added Toggle for ancients that are max level for less clutter.
